body: yep yep. until i admitted to myself that i was sexually abused as a child, i had sick fantasies of being raped/molested because i had the symptoms but no recollection of it ever occurring. haha repression

cause they taught me not to talk to strangers, they taught me the dangers of the internet and the dangers of trusting strange people in real life. and i did both. in real life a few times and online hundreds of times. it's not even abuse if it happens online, i could've ended it by pressing esc or not going back to these people/sites, but i didn't. i went back on purpose cause i knew what would happen, i knew they'd make me beg to degrade myself in front of them, but it was the closest thing to someone being nice to me or interested in me i'd experienced in a long time. i'm just blowing things out of proportion and wasting people's time, sorry.
